summary: Frontend Phase-1 homepage verification completed on preview and static build output. SEO/static checks pass for required homepage H1/canonical/tagline/counters/discovery links, and SEO regression re-run is PASS with 0 critical failures (43 non-blocking warnings baseline). Desktop hero hierarchy and integration checks pass. One mobile layout defect found: hero CTA row intersects fixed bottom navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: Primary hero CTA (Explore Solutions) overlaps fixed mobile bottom nav by ~1.5px at 390x844; CTA row is not safely above nav.

issues: CTA row vertical spacing is too tight against fixed bottom nav; requires safe-area/margin buffer.
Cookie consent banner can occupy hero lower area and compete with CTA visibility before consent.

action_items: Adjust mobile hero CTA container bottom spacing/safe-area so both CTAs stay fully above [data-testid='mobile-bottom-nav'] at 390x844.
Re-validate hero with cookie banner visible to ensure CTA discoverability remains acceptable on first visit.
Keep existing single-H1/canonical/prerender architecture unchanged while applying spacing fix.
critical_code_review_comments: Selector namespace collision: [data-testid='home-solution-paths'] shares the same prefix as solution cards (home-solution-*), which increases false positives in automated card counting.
Hero CTA row uses fixed-style visual placement near viewport bottom while mobile bottom-nav is also fixed; introduce explicit safe-area logic to prevent overlap regressions.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested checks passed except mobile CTA-above-nav requirement)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed with Playwright on preview URL. Mobile metrics at 390x844: primary CTA bottom=764.08, mobile-bottom-nav top=762.61 (overlap). Desktop checks passed: single runtime h1, tagline + CTA hierarchy visible, 0 console errors. Static build checks passed: exactly one <h1>, required hero text/counters/links present. node seo-regression.js result: PASS, failCount=0, warnCount=43.
rca of the issue: Root cause is spacing conflict in hero content placement on mobile: CTA row sits too close to viewport bottom while mobile bottom navigation is fixed at the bottom, causing geometric intersection. Reproduction: open homepage on 390x844 and inspect bounding boxes for home-hero-primary-cta vs mobile-bottom-nav.
